name: Jutsu Focus
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ninja 1st, secret technique class feature.

Benefit(s): The DCs to resist your secret techniques are increased by 1. In addition, you are always treated as though you had 1 jutsu for the purpose of 0-cost secret techniques.
